answer: Each agent bonds one glacier nectar plot with 70 credits and files a fable each epoch: a key-signed record of nectar gathered, serial filed once. An auditor checks filed nectar against the public glacier yield table, allowing 3% error; a mismatch, reused fable, or reused serial burns the bond. A rented fable fails: serial bears another key. First filing 35, k-th 35+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,531,500 and lock 70,000 for 40,000; honest pays 35 once.
